Le ALII: e, ua ou manatii i au faamasinoga talu anamua, ona faamafanafanaina ai lea o a‘u. Ua maua a‘u e le tiga tele ona o e amio leaga, e ua lafoaiina lau tulafono. HETA Le ALII e, o lo‘u tofi lava oe, ua Ou fai atu, Ou te tausi i au afioga. Ua ou faatoga atu i ou luma ma loʻu loto atoa; ia e alofa mai ia te au e tusa ma lau afioga. Ua siomia aʻu i mailei a e amio leaga; ua le galo ia te au o lau tulafono. Ou te ala i le tulua o po e vivii atu ai ia te oe, ona o au faamasinoga tonu. Ua matou uo ma i latou uma o e matatau ia te oe, ma e ua tausi i au feau. Le ALII e, ua tumu le lalolagi i lou alofa; ia e aʻoaʻo mai ia te au i au tulafono.

verses.en: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.
Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.
Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.
Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.
It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.
I know, O LORD, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.
Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.
Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.
Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
verses.sm: TETA Le ALI e, ua e agalelei mai i lau auauna, e tusa ma lau afioga. Ia e a'oa'o mai ia te au i le faautauta lelei ma le poto; aua ua ou faamaoni i au poloaiga. A o lei puapuagatia a'u na Ou sese; a o lenei, ua ou tausi i lau afioga. E lelei oe, ua e agalelei foi; Ia e aʻoaʻo mai ia te au i au tulafono. Ua fata fua e ua faamaualuga le tala pepelo ia te au; o aʻu, Ou te anaana i au feau ma loʻu loto atoa. Ua lololo o latou loto e pei o le ga‘o; o aʻu, ou te olioli lava i lau tulafono. O le mea e lelei ai aʻu ina ua puapuagatia aʻu, ina ja a'oa'oina ai a‘u i au tulafono. E sili ona lelei ia te au o le tulafono a lou fofoga i afe o auro ma ario. IOTA Na faia aʻu e ou aao, ua saunia ai foi au; ia e faalotomatala mai ia te au, ina ia aʻoaʻoina lava aʻu i au poloaiga. O e matatau ia te oe latou te iloa mai aʻu, ona fiafia lea o i latou; aua ua ou faamoemoe i lau afioga. Le ALTI e, ua ou iloa e tonu lava au faamasinoga, na e faapuapuagatia foi a‘u i le faamaoni. Ia fai lou alofa ma faamatalaloto ia te au, e tusa ma lau afioga i lau auauna. Ia oo mai ia te au lou alofa mutimuti vale, ia ou ola ai; aua > lau tulafono, o loʻu fiafia lea. verses.en: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.
How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.
All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.
Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.
I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.
I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.

verses.en: It is time for thee, LORD, to work: for they have made void thy law.
verses.sm: O lau auauna aʻu nei, ia e faalotomatala mai ia te au, ina ia ou iloa au tulafono.

verses.en: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
verses.sm: Ua oo mai ona po e galue ai le ALII; ua solia e i latou lau tulafono.

verses.en: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ua sili ai loʻu manao i au poloaiga i le auro, O le auro lelei lava. O le mea lea ou te manatu ai ua tonu au feau atoa uma lava;

verses.en: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
verses.sm: ou te ‘ino‘ino i ala pepelo uma lava. PE O mea e ofo ai au tulafono,

verses.en: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
verses.sm: o le mea lea e anaana i ai lo‘u loto. O le faaalia mai o au afioga e faamalamalamaina ai;

verses.en: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
verses.sm: e faalotomatalaina ai e ua faigofie. Ua faamaga loʻu gutu, ma ou ga‘ega‘e;

verses.en: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
verses.sm: aua ua ou naunau atu i au poloaiga. Ia e liuliualo mai ia te au, ma alofa fua mai ia te au,

verses.en: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.sm: e pei ona e masani ai i e alolofa i lou suafa. Ta e faamautuina loʻu savali i lau afioga;

verses.en: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
verses.sm: aua foi ne“ manumalo mai se amio leaga e tasi ia te au. Laveai mai ia te au i le sauaga a tagata;

verses.en: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
verses.sm: ona ou tausi lea i au feau. Ia faamalamalama mai ou fofoga i lau auauna;

verses.en: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
verses.sm: ma aʻoaʻo mai ia te au i au tulafono. O loo tafe ifo o vaitafe i oʻu mata,

verses.en: Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.
verses.sm: aua e le tausi e i latou lau tulafono. SATI E amiotonu lava oe, le ALII e,

verses.en: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
verses.sm: ua tonu foi au faamasinoga. Ua e poloai mai i au tulafono ua tonu, ma le faamaoni lava.

verses.en: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
verses.sm: Ua faaumatia aʻu i loʻu maelega, ina ua galo i e saua mai ia te au au afioga.

verses.en: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.
Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.
The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.
I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.
They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.
Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
Great are thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.
Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
verses.sm: Ua se ario ua teia ma le otaota lau afioga; e naunau foi i ai lau auauna. E faatauvaa lava au, ma inosia; a e le galo ia te au au feau. O lau amiotonu o le amiotonu e faavavau lea; o le raea moni foi lau tulafono. Ua maua aʻu e le puapuaga ma le tiga; o au poloaiga ou te fiafia i ai. O au tulafono o mea tonu ia e faavavau; ia e fialotomatala mai ia te au, ou te ola ai. KOFA Ua ou valaau atu ia te oe ma le loto atoa; le ALII e, ia e tali mai ia te au; ou te anaana lava i au tulafono. Ua ou valaau ia te 06; ia e faaola mai ia te au, ona cu tausi lea i au tulafono. Ua muamua i le tafa o ata ona ou alaga atu; ua ou faamoemoe i lau afioga. Ua muamua ona pupula oʻu mata i leoleoga i itu po, ina ia ou mafaufau i lau afioga. Ia e faafofoga mai i loʻu leo e tusa ma lou alofa; le ALI e, ia e faaolaola mai ia te au e tusa ma lau faamasinoga. O loo faalatalata mai e ua tausisi i amio leaga; e vava mamao i latou ma lau tulafono. Ua latalata mai oe le ALI e; o au poloaiga uma foi e moni lava ia. Talu anamua ua ou iloa ai au tulafono, ua e faavaeina ia e faavavau. RESA Silasila mai ia i loʻu tiga, ma ia e laveai mai ia te au; aua e le galo ia te au lau tulafono. Ia e faia laʻu finauga, ma laveai mai ja te au; ia e faaolaola mai ia te au e tusa ma lau afioga. E vava mamao le faaolataga ma i latou O e amio leaga; aua e le saili i latou i au tulafono. Le ALII e, ua tele lou alofa mutimuti vale; ia e faaolaola mai ia te au e tusa ma au faamasinoga. E toarele o e saua mai ma ita mai ia te au; ou te le liliu ese lava i au tulafono. Na ou iloa atu i e ua faa‘ole‘ole, ma ou “ino'ino i ai, o i latou o e le tausi i lau afioga.

verses.en: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.
verses.sm: 160 161 162 164 165 166 167 168 170 171 172 173 174 175 la e silasila mai ua ou naunau i au feau;

verses.en: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.
verses.sm: le ALII e, ia e faaolaola mai ia te au e tu3a ma lou alofa. E moni lava lau afioga talu le amataga;

verses.en: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
verses.sm: e faavavau foi au faamasinoga tonu uma lava. SINA Ua saua fua mai alii ia te au; a ua fefe loʻu loto i au afioga.

verses.en: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
verses.sm: Ou te fiafia a'u i lau afioga, faapei o le ua maua le vete tele.

verses.en: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
verses.sm: Ou te ʻinoʻino i le tala pepelo, ou te matua “ino'ino i ai;

verses.en: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.sm: a Ou te naunau i lau tulafono. E taʻi foi faafitu i aso ona Ou vivii atu ia te oe,

verses.en: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
verses.sm: ona o au faamasinoga tonu. Ua tele le filemu o e naunau i lau tulafono;

verses.en: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
verses.sm: e leai foi se mea e tausuai ai i latou. Le ALII e, ua ou faamoemoe i lau olataga,

verses.en: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
verses.sm: ma aʻu faja au poloaiga. Ua tausi au tulafono i loʻu loto; ma ou matua naunau i ai.

verses.en: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.
verses.sm: Ua ou tausi i au feau, atoa ma au tulafono; aua o i ou luma oʻu ala uma lava.

verses.en: Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.
verses.sm: TAU Le ALII e, ia oo atu laʻu alaga i ou luma; ia e faalotomatala mai ia te au, e tusa ma lau afioga.

verses.en: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
verses.sm: Ta oo atu i ou luma laʻu aioi atu; ia e laveai mai ia te au, e tusa ma lau afioga.

verses.en: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
verses.sm: E taʻu atu le viiga i oʻu laugutu, pe a e aʻoaʻo mai ia te au i au tulafono.

verses.en: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
verses.sm: E tautala loʻu laulaufaiva i lau afioga, aua ua tonu au poloaiga uma lava.

verses.en: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
verses.sm: Ia fesoasoani mai lou aao ia te au; aua ua ou filifilia au feau.

verses.en: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law is my delight.
verses.sm: Le ALII e, ou te naunau i lau faaolataga; o lau tulafono foi, o loʻu lea fiafia.

verses.en: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
verses.sm: Ia ola lava aʻu, ina 1a ou vivii atu ia te oe; ia fesoasoani mai foi au faamasinoga ia te au.

verses.en: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
verses.sm: Ua ou alu ese faapei o le mamoe ua se; ia e saili mai i lau auauna; aua ua le galo ia te au au poloaiga.
